expense_id.description: Expense ID to comment on. Example: 5123

content.description: Comment content. Example: "Does this include the delivery fee?"

cost.description: Cost of the expense as a string with 2 decimal places. Example: "10.00"

group_id.description: Group ID, or 0 for non-group expenses

date.description: Date of the expense in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-06-05T13:00:00Z"

split_equally.description: If true, split equally among group members (requires group_id)

users.description: List of users with shares (required unless split_equally is true)

paid_share.description: Amount paid by this user, e.g. "10.00"

owed_share.description: Amount owed by this user, e.g. "5.00"

user_email.description: Email address of the friend to add. Example: "ada@example.com"

user_first_name.description: First name of the friend. Example: "Ada"

user_last_name.description: Last name of the friend. Example: "Lovelace"

group_type.description: What is the group used for?

users.description: Users to add to the group. The current user is added by default.

user_id.description: User ID of an existing user to add. Example: 5823

actions.description: Delete or archive a comment in Splitwise.
actions.name: delete-comment

actions.description: Delete or archive an expense in Splitwise.
actions.name: delete-expense

expense_id.description: ID of the expense to delete. Example: 51023

actions.description: Delete or archive a friend in Splitwise
actions.name: delete-friend

friend_id.description: User ID of the friend to delete. Example: 12345

actions.description: Delete or archive a group in Splitwise.
actions.name: delete-group

actions.description: Retrieve a single expense from Splitwise.
actions.name: get-expense

actions.description: Retrieve a single friend from Splitwise.
actions.name: get-friend

id.description: User ID of the friend. Example: 123

actions.description: Retrieve a single group from Splitwise.
actions.name: get-group

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (offset) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of expenses to return. Defaults to 20.

group_id.description: If provided, only expenses in that group will be returned.

friend_id.description: ID of another user. If provided, only expenses between the current and provided user will be returned.

dated_after.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Return expenses later than this date.

dated_before.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Return expenses earlier than this date.

updated_after.description: Return expenses updated after this date.

updated_before.description: Return expenses updated before this date.

id.description: ID of the expense to update. Example: 51023

cost.description: A string representation of a decimal value, limited to 2 decimal places. Example: "25.00"

description.description: A short description of the expense. Example: "Grocery run"

date.description: The date and time the expense took place. Example: "2012-05-02T13:00:00Z"

currency_code.description: A currency code. Must be in the list from get_currencies. Example: "USD"

category_id.description: A category id from get_categories. Example: 15

group_id.description: The group to put this expense in, or 0 to create an expense outside of a group. Example: 391

users.description: List of user shares. If any values are supplied, all shares for the expense will be overwritten.

first_name.description: First name of the user. Example: "Neu"

last_name.description: Last name of the user. Example: "Yewzer"

paid_share.description: Decimal amount as a string with 2 decimal places. Example: "25.00"

owed_share.description: Decimal amount as a string with 2 decimal places. Example: "13.55"
